items.description: "How the change is pushed and checked": "change everything and push it all out in one go, and then stop." Starting the run is the operator's OK for that push (Ruling P1). Every repo the slice committed to is pushed in one go, JenkinsPipelineUtils first, and no consumer before it is on origin. AaC/Architecture was disabled before the first push, re-enabled once the queue was quiet and built once by hand (Ruling P2). Until then its live file calls `containerTemplates.k8s`/`python` and the positional `helmCharts.kaniko` (`/work/Architecture/Jenkinsfile:39-40, 141`). No other build was started by hand, except one build each of the eight renamed-repo jobs on `main` (Ruling R2). Quiet is an empty queue and no running builds. An item that waited on "nodes offline" past about 60 minutes was checked against the Kubernetes cloud's provisioning counter and the live agents before any reset (Ruling T1). The check is one Jenkins API pull of every job's `lastBuild` against the push time. Every build the push started finished SUCCESS, and so did AaC/Architecture's one build. That includes the eight OTA uploads, the prd app rollouts through the pin writers and KubeCoder's dev rollout (S8).
items.rationale: Pushed in order (JPU first), AaC/Architecture paused/resumed and built once, quiet reached. But not every build finished SUCCESS: ElectronicsInventory #262 FAILURE (P14), YouTrackConfiguration #9 FAILURE (P13), and eight jobs never built (V11).
